long_biography.plain_text:
Jeff Bezos studied electrical engineering and computer science at Princeton before moving into finance and quantitative investment work. At D.E. Shaw, the rapid growth of the web prompted him to leave and build an online bookshop in 1994. Books offered a vast catalogue suited to search, and Amazon grew from that focused opening into a platform spanning retail, logistics, devices and cloud computing.

Bezos later channelled the same appetite for long-horizon infrastructure into space. He founded Blue Origin in 2000 to lower the cost and improve the safety of spaceflight, with reusable launch vehicles at the centre of its approach. The venture extended his engineering interests beyond digital commerce towards building a durable route to space for future generations.
